notes.title: Majotori v2.2.0 update: More questions, less disk space
notes.content:
In this time of witches, what's scarier than your own ignorance?

To celebrate Halloween, we are updating Majotori with a new batch of questions to help keep the collection up to date and relevant. I also includes some corrections and a new compression method that reduces the disk size of the game by about 40%. Not that that means much since the game is already pretty light, but hey!

Also, in case you missed it, remember that now you can make your own custom questions file to use in the game. More info here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/588730/discussions/0/1473096694452211166/

Since Majotori fits to an extent with the Halloween theme, we have decided to make our biggest discount yet. If you wanted to gift the game to a friend, now is the time! Don't expect a deal this good to be repeated any time soon!

If you have any doubt or problem, you can reach us on the Steam forums or send us an email at contact@majorariatto.com

notes.title: Majotori v2.1.0 update: Custom questions
notes.content:
It's probably not something that most of you would want to use, and it works a bit like a hack, but some of you were asking for it and it might allow you some fun moments with your friends, so in this update we added the possibility to override Majotori's questions with your own.

How does it work?

1) Create a .txt file called "custom_questions".

2) Fill it with questions using this format:

Question
Correct answer
Incorrect answer
Incorrect answer
Incorrect answer

3) Place the file in either the folder where the Majotori executable is or in this OS specific one:

Windows:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Majorariatto/Majotori/

OSX:
~/Library/Application Support/unity.Majorariatto.Majotori/

Linux:
~/.config/unity3d/Majorariatto/Majotori/

4) That's it! Run the game and it will override the questions with the ones in that file.

For more details refer to the readme. You can access it online here:
http://www.majorariatto.com/readme/majotori/v2_1/en.txt

And if you have any doubt or problem, you can reach us on the Steam forums or send us an email at contact@majorariatto.com
